name: Cobalt Strike beacon on ENG-WS-27
label: incident
description: EDR confirmed a Cobalt Strike beacon on ENG-WS-27. Host isolated, credentials reset, case closed as a true positive.

notes.title: Closure rationale
notes.content: Closed as True Positive. The beacon was confirmed by EDR and by netflow, the host was isolated before any lateral movement was observed, and the affected account's credentials were reset. No other hosts showed the implant.
notes.author: s.varga

actions.message: Network containment applied to ENG-WS-27; host confirmed contained by the agent.

actions.name: disable_account
actions.message: Account r.mensah disabled pending credential reset.
